MALAYSIA · 2026 Voluntary programme

Petronas and RHB set up financing for ESG-ready vendors

RHB and Petronas signed an MoU for a Sustainable Vendor Financing Programme for oil and gas services vendors enrolled in Petronas' Supplier Support Programme. Joining that programme starts with an ESG maturity assessment. The programme is voluntary, so this is an incentive, not a purchasing ban.

Source: Business Today, 29 Apr 2026

MALAYSIA · 2026 Supplier screening

TNB assessed 935 suppliers on sustainability

Tenaga Nasional's 2025 sustainability report says it ran a Vendor Sustainability Assessment covering 935 suppliers, about RM5.4 billion of procurement spend. It looked at environment, labour and human rights, governance and transition readiness.

Source: Pacifica ESG, on TNB Sustainability Report 2025

MALAYSIA · 2025 Supplier screening

Maybank screens new suppliers on ESG, targets 2030

Maybank's 2025 report says all newly onboarded suppliers were screened for ESG and sets a goal for all suppliers to meet ESG criteria by 2030, supported by supplier workshops.

Source: Maybank Sustainability & Environmental Report 2025

MALAYSIA · Jul 2025 Expectations cascading

Wasco helps SME vendors track emissions

Engineering group Wasco hosted a Sustainability Day for vendors. It noted that many suppliers sit outside direct regulation but face growing expectations as Malaysia's reporting rules phase in, and offered support on tracking GHG emissions.

Source: Wasco press release, 23 Jul 2025

MALAYSIA · Jun 2024 Platform and financing

Bursa launches CSI Solution for companies of all sizes

Bursa Malaysia's Centralised Sustainability Intelligence Solution supports ESG data reporting and supply chain decarbonisation. It is open to SMEs, listed or not, with preferential financing through participating banks.

Source: Malay Mail / Bernama, 21 Jun 2024

SINGAPORE · 2024-2026 Regulation pushing down

SGX: Scope 1 and 2 from FY2025, Scope 3 for large issuers from FY2026

SGX RegCo made emissions reporting mandatory for listed issuers, with Scope 3 for Straits Times Index constituents from FY2026. Issuers collecting value-chain data will ask their suppliers for it. Large non-listed companies follow from FY2030.

Source: ESG Today; Slaughter and May (APAC 2025)

INDONESIA · 2025-2026 Regulation

Indonesia adopts IFRS-aligned sustainability standards

Indonesia's PSPK, aligned with IFRS S1 and S2, was ratified in July 2025. A three-stage mandatory rollout followed an OJK consultation in early 2026.

Source: ESGpedia, Asia regulation guide

INDONESIA / THAILAND / VIETNAM · Feb 2025 Buyer programme

IKEA extends supplier renewable-electricity programme to Indonesia and Thailand

IKEA added Indonesia and Thailand to its programme helping suppliers switch to renewable electricity. In Vietnam, covered earlier, suppliers' renewable share rose 40 percentage points to 84% between FY23 and FY24.

Source: ESG Today, 5 Feb 2025

THAILAND · 2026 Regulation

Thailand: ISSB-aligned climate reporting for large-caps from 2026

Thailand's SEC has mandated sustainability disclosure for listed companies, with ISSB-aligned climate reporting starting in 2026 for large-cap companies.

Source: Socious, 12 Apr 2026

VIETNAM · 2026 Buyer requirement

Vietnam's electronics firms told ESG is becoming a condition for supplier lists

Industry speakers reported by Viet Nam News said international buyers increasingly weigh ESG, emissions, traceability and clean energy alongside quality and price, and that ESG is becoming a condition for getting onto supplier lists.

Source: Viet Nam News (repost)

CHINA · 2026 Regulation pushing down

450+ Chinese listed companies filed first mandatory sustainability reports. Suppliers are next

First mandatory reports, covering 2025, were due by 30 April 2026. Reporting on supply chain security and Scope 3 needs primary data from the suppliers that sell into these companies.

Source: Socious, 5 Sep 2026

CHINA / INDONESIA · 2026 Audit

Chinese-backed nickel processors in Indonesia undergo ESG supply-chain audits

An IISD report says several Chinese-backed nickel processors in Indonesia have completed external ESG-related supply chain audits to meet due diligence requirements.

Source: IISD, May 2026

GLOBAL · Ongoing Binding on suppliers

Apple makes supplier emissions reporting a contract term

Apple's Supplier Code of Conduct (v4.10, effective 1 Nov 2023) requires suppliers to keep GHG inventories and report Apple-related emissions each year. It is built into supplier agreements, so it binds suppliers who want to work with Apple.

Source: Seedling, 2026 guide

GLOBAL · 2026 Buyer programme

Walmart's Project Gigaton: supplier reporting is visible to buyers

Participating suppliers report annually through Walmart's Sustainability Hub or CDP. Participation status is visible to buying teams and influences procurement decisions.

Source: Aclymate, 2026

BRUNEI · - Not found

No verified Brunei case yet

We have not found a verified news item showing a Brunei buyer requiring supplier ESG reports. This will be added once a reliable source is confirmed.

MALAYSIA · 2020-2021 Import ban

Top Glove barred from the US over forced labour

US Customs issued a Withhold Release Order against Top Glove subsidiaries in July 2020, allowing shipments to be seized. Imports resumed after a September 2021 modification, once Top Glove had paid more than USD 30 million in remediation to workers and improved conditions. MIDF analysts estimated 25 to 30% of its FY22 earnings forecast came from the US.

Source: US Department of Labor · The Borneo Post (analysts)

MALAYSIA · 2021-2023 Import ban

Supermax's US glove exports blocked for about two years

A US ban took effect in October 2021 after CBP found 10 of 11 ILO forced-labour indicators. Kenanga noted the US made up about 20% of Supermax's sales and that the earlier Top Glove ban took almost a year to clear. CBP lifted the order in September 2023 after remediation.

Source: Malay Mail, 21 Oct 2021 · US CBP, Sep 2023

MALAYSIA · 2020-2026 Import ban

FGV's palm oil order lasted over five years

CBP's September 2020 order against FGV palm oil found all 11 ILO forced-labour indicators. It was modified in CBP's fiscal year 2026, after FGV corrected the issues. CBP says it has issued and modified eight orders and findings against Malaysian palm oil and glove makers since 2019.

Source: US CBP

GLOBAL · 2026 Costly default values

EU CBAM: no verified emissions data means higher default values

Since 1 January 2026, EU importers of steel, aluminium, cement and similar goods need verified emissions data from their non-EU producers. If a supplier cannot provide it, the importer must use conservative default values, with a mark-up of 10% in 2026 rising to 30% from 2028. Buyers may switch to suppliers that can provide data. This affects exporters in Malaysia and across Asia.

Source: XcelGreen · Envify

SINGAPORE / VIETNAM · Jan 2025 Greenwashing ruling

VietJet's campaign banned in Singapore for unproven green claims

Singapore's advertising watchdog ASAS banned a VietJet promotional campaign in January 2025 after ruling its environmental claims were unsubstantiated. Its first greenwashing finding came in December 2023 against PRISM+. Environmental claims need evidence.

Source: DLA Piper

MALAYSIA · Mar 2026 Regulator reprimand

Bursa reprimands TFP Solutions over an inaccurate annual report

Bursa publicly reprimanded TFP Solutions and its CEO for an annual report that wrongly said all directors had completed mandatory training. This is a governance disclosure case, not a sustainability-statement case, but it shows Bursa acts on inaccurate disclosures.

Source: Malay Mail, 6 Mar 2026
